scripts.features:
ROB IT Script 06/02/2026

⚠️ This script works ONLY on PC (Windows Desktop Executor Required)

Master every heist in the hottest Roblox stealth robbery simulator with our complete free automation tool. Break into buildings, collect all valuables, avoid guards, and escape to your van effortlessly on any difficulty. Works with all missions, classes, and tools. Updated and fully functional in the latest version.

Features:

[+] Auto Rob - [Automatically completes full heist missions from start to finish including breaking in, stealing all items, and returning to the escape van]

[+] Auto Loot All Items - [Instantly collects every stealable valuable in the building regardless of rarity without triggering guard alerts]

[+] Guard ESP - [Displays all guard NPC positions, patrol routes, detection cones, and alert status through walls in real time]

[+] Item ESP - [Highlights all collectible valuables, safes, ATMs, and hidden loot on the current map with color-coded rarity indicators]

[+] Silent Steal - [Removes all noise from crowbar, lockpick, and dynamite actions so guards are never alerted by your tools]

[+] Auto Lockpick - [Instantly completes the lockpicking mini-game with a perfect result every time without manual input]

[+] Auto Open Vaults - [Uses lazer cutter to automatically open all vaults and safes on the map collecting maximum loot per run]

[+] Speed Boost - [Increases character movement speed for faster building traversal and quicker van escapes on all difficulty levels]

[+] Magnet Aura - [Functions like the Mythical Magnet tool pulling all stealable items directly into your backpack from extended range]

[+] Anti-Guard Detection - [Makes your character invisible to all guard NPCs so you can walk freely through any building undetected]

[+] Auto Complete Quests - [Automatically finishes all active daily and weekly quests for bonus Gold Coins and Diamonds rewards]

[+] Teleport to Van - [One-click instant teleport back to the escape van when your backpack is full for zero-risk extraction]

[+] Infinite Tool Durability - [Prevents all equipped tools from breaking or running out of uses during heist missions]
